title: Finite closed cover cohomology vanishing
statement: Let X be a Noetherian topological space, let q be a nonnegative integer, and let S be a finite collection of closed subsets whose union is X. If H^q(Z,G) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero for every Z in S and every abelian sheaf G on Z with its subspace topology, then H^q(X,F) is zero for every abelian sheaf F on X.

proof.text: Induct on the number of closed cover members. An empty cover forces X empty; the empty-cover sheaf axiom gives zero cohomology in every degree.

For a chosen member Z and the closed union W of the remaining members, let U=X\Z and apply the open-closed short exact sequence. Since closure(U) is contained in W, its support clause writes the left term as a closed pushforward from W, by composing the inclusion of closure(U) into W.

The remaining cover members, regarded as closed subspaces of W, have the same intrinsic topology as before. Induction kills the cohomology of every sheaf on W; the cover hypothesis kills every sheaf on Z. Closed-immersion comparison and the long exact sequence then kill the middle degree-q group. At q=0 use left exactness.

    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
